title: Titanium Endoscope Sheath
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for Titanium Endoscope Sheath where intermediate strength between CP titanium and Ti-6Al-4V is needed with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile strength with 20% elongation enables 30% weight reduction versus steel while allowing tube bending and flaring without intermediate annealing — critical for Rigid endoscope outer protective sheath requiring complex-formed geometries. This rationale is driven by rigid endoscope outer protective sheath and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for surgical instruments geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for rigid endoscope outer application
commonFailures: Fatigue fracture at thread root under cyclic bending - resolved by thread rolling (not cutting) for compressive stress — critical for rigid endoscope outer performance

faq.q: What material traceability is provided with Titanium Endoscope Sheath?
faq.a: Each Titanium Endoscope Sheath shipment includes full material traceability from ingot to finished component with EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificates documenting heat analysis and mechanical properties. Process traceability covers all manufacturing steps with batch records, inspection results, and device history records — compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485 requirements.
